profile.name: Adharsh P S
profile.tagline: I build fast, polished Flutter apps for Android, iOS, Web and Windows Desktop, from clean architecture to REST APIs and ERP integrations.

about.intro: I'm Adharsh P S, a Flutter Developer with 2+ years of industry experience. I currently work as a Junior Flutter Developer at Odox SoftHub LLP, building enterprise cross-platform applications for Android, iOS, Web and Windows Desktop. I work with Clean Architecture, MVVM and Provider, and I'm experienced in REST APIs, JWT authentication, offline-first sync and Odoo ERP integrations.
about.journey:
I started with a Flutter internship at Luminar Technolab, Kochi, where I built a solid foundation in mobile development. I then joined Avanzo Cyber Security Solutions, Thrissur, as a Product Developer, shipping apps to the Play Store and App Store and building backends with Django and PHP. In January 2026 I moved to Odox SoftHub LLP, where I build offline-first warehouse apps, biometric attendance sync tools and enterprise SaaS products backed by Odoo.
I enjoy solving real-world problems with clean architecture, scalable code and intuitive UI, and I'm always eager to learn and collaborate.

projects.title: Attendance Synchronization System
projects.description: Flutter Windows Desktop app used in production by an enterprise client. Integrates ZKTeco biometric devices with Odoo ERP to automate user and attendance log retrieval via secure device communication and REST API sync, replacing manual reconciliation.

projects.title: Supply Chain Management App
projects.description: Offline-first Flutter app (Android & iOS) for warehouse operations as a SaaS product: ASN receiving and put-away with batch handling, barcode scanning across Honeywell, Zebra and camera scanners, order picking with tote assignment, and packing. Syncs via Hive and Dio with an Odoo ERP backend.

projects.title: Office Management App
projects.description: Enterprise Flutter app (Android & iOS) built as a SaaS product for business clients. Covers attendance, expenses, leave, payslips and events with manager login, JWT authentication, encrypted local storage and an Odoo ERP backend.

projects.title: API Testing Tool (Postman Clone)
projects.description: Cross-platform REST client for Windows Desktop and Web with a request builder, collections, environments, request history and Firebase API testing support, built to improve internal developer workflow.

projects.title: UdaanCheck
projects.description: Travel-assist app for Android and iOS covering airline luggage rules, released on the Play Store and App Store.

projects.title: CyberHulk
projects.description: Cyber-awareness Android application published on Google Play.

projects.title: NoteFlow
projects.description: Lightweight offline-first notes application built with Flutter following Clean Architecture. Features Hive local storage, AI-assisted content refinement, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.title: Paws (Pet Marketplace)
projects.description: User-to-user pet marketplace for listing and browsing pets, built with BLoC state management. Uses Firebase authentication and Firestore, with Cloudinary for media storage in a hybrid cloud setup.

projects.title: Netflix UI Clone
projects.description: Visually faithful recreation of the Netflix mobile interface with dynamic hero banners, categorized movie carousels, responsive layout scaling, and fluid animations.

points: Build and maintain enterprise cross-platform apps (Android, iOS, Windows Desktop, Web) with Flutter and Dart using Clean Architecture, SOLID and MVVM, in a 3-person team (2 frontend, 1 backend).
Integrate REST APIs, manage state with Provider, implement JWT authentication with Flutter Secure Storage, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Codemagic).
Deliver offline-first experiences with Hive, SharedPreferences and local-to-server sync for warehouse and field use cases with unreliable connectivity.
Shipped a production Windows Desktop app integrating ZKTeco biometric devices with Odoo ERP, replacing manual attendance reconciliation.
Use AI-assisted development (Antigravity) to speed up feature delivery and reduce development cycle time.

experience.company: Avanzo Cyber Security Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Thrissur
points: Developed and shipped cross-platform apps (Android, iOS, Web) with Flutter, including UdaanCheck and CyberHulk on the Play Store and App Store.
Built secure, scalable backend services and REST APIs with Django (Python) and PHP for production mobile and web clients.
Implemented JWT authentication, secure session handling and role-based access control.
Resolved cross-platform performance and security issues and managed Play Store and App Store release cycles.
Delivered a hospital management system (web and mobile) with an integrated backend for an external client.
Built Android and iOS apps with Flutter and Dart, implementing state management and responsive UI.
Integrated REST APIs and Firebase (Cloud Storage, Realtime Database, Authentication).
Added local storage for offline support, improving usability and reliability.
